Driver assumptions

Every model input, its distribution, and the rationale reviewers signed off on

DriverTypeDistMeanStdBoundsRationale
g_imstochastictruncnorm0.050.03[—, 0.12]Innovative Medicine, 10y average from year 2. FY22-25 reported growth +1.7/+4.2/+4.0/+6.0% while absorbing the STELARA loss of exclusivity (~690bp drag in Q3-26); organic ~4% plus f x 2pp acquired. Std 3% (above IBM software's 2.5%): patent cliffs and trial readouts make the decade outcome wider. hi 12%: no decade precedent above that at $60B scale.
g_medtechstochastictruncnorm0.0450.02[—, 0.09]MedTech, 10y average from year 2. FY22-25 +1.4/+10.8 (Abiomed)/+4.8/+6.1% (Shockwave); organic ~3.5% plus f x 2pp acquired. The planned Orthopaedics separation is NOT modeled (segment kept whole).
core_marginstochasticnormal0.2080.02—Pre-SBC, pre-M&A FCFF margin at the FY2025 level: (OCF 24.53 - capex 4.83 - after-tax net interest 0.07) / revenue 94.19 = 20.8%; FY2024 21.8%. Endpoint, not mean (IBM F19 rule). FY2022-23 excluded: their OCF includes Kenvue while revenue is recast (same landmine as IBM FY2019-20).
margin_mix_driftdeterministicnormal0——DETERMINISTIC 0 -> +0.4pp by y10: Innovative Medicine (FY2025 pre-tax segment margin 36.9%) grows faster than MedTech (12.2%) at the means.
sbc_ratiodeterministicnormal0.0143——DETERMINISTIC 1.43% (FY2025 1.35B / 94.19B); flat since FY2021 (1.45%), so no ramp, unlike IBM.
ma_ratiostochastictruncnorm0.1160.04[0, —]Acquisition spend % of revenue FY21-25: 0.1/22.1/0.0/17.1/18.6% (Abiomed, Shockwave, Intra-Cellular), mean 11.6%; FY16-25 ~12.7% with Actelion. Std 4%: one draw per path, so decade-average dispersion of a very lumpy series (annual sigma ~14% / sqrt(10)). lo 0 at 2.9 sigma.
ma_recurrencedeterministicnormal0.5——DETERMINISTIC f=0.50, the IBM headline convention, paired with the growth credit. First-pass caveat: in pharma, acquired pipeline revenue turns 'organic' after one year, so the 2pp acquired-growth credit likely understates what M&A buys; the f-locus is published.
rfstochastictruncnorm0.0510.005[0.01, —]10y Treasury 5.10% (^TNX close 2026-10-16); std 0.5% = permanent-component uncertainty (IBM convention).
betadeterministicnormal0.65——DETERMINISTIC judgment 0.65. Regression betas are unusable: 0.22 (5y monthly) and ~0 (2y weekly) vs the S&P 500; Blume-adjusted 0.48. 0.65 sits between that and a pharma/medtech industry beta; locus 0.45 / 0.65 / 0.85 published.
erpstochastictruncnorm0.0420.0075[0.02, —]Damodaran implied ERP 4.20% (Oct 1, 2026); std 0.75% (IBM convention).
kd_spreaddeterministicnormal0.004——DETERMINISTIC +40bp over rf: AAA-rated issuer (first-pass estimate, not calibrated to the debt ladder).
tax_ratedeterministicnormal0.21——DETERMINISTIC statutory 21%.
equity_weightdeterministicnormal0.93——DETERMINISTIC E/V 0.93: market cap ~$616B (255.56 x 2.41B) vs net debt $41.1B. Not iterated to the price-value fixed point (first pass).
terminal_growthstochasticnormal0.02250.0075—Long-run nominal growth 2.25%, std 0.75% (IBM convention).

Mechanical vintages: parameters (trailing revenue CAGR, FCF-margin mean/std over ≤5 annuals) derive from each vintage's point-in-time filings alone — no judgment inputs, no forward information. Sampling mirrors the aggregate engine (one growth and one margin draw per path). Operating projections only — no WACC, no terminal value.

filed_date visibility: a period enters a vintage only once filed; companyfacts-sourced figures can carry a later filing's date, so a vintage may see fewer periods than a real-time observer did (the conservative direction). Actuals are as currently reported — restatements included, deliberately asymmetric.

Skipped vintage dates (insufficient history): 2018-03-31, 2019-03-30, 2020-03-28, 2021-04-03.
